payload.summary: Remove PR 3538 leftovers once the 30-day dead-code window passes (after 13 Nov 2026)
payload.detail: The /api/proxy route only replies authenticated and nothing calls it. scripts/recalculate-answer-support-labels.ts and its test are run by nothing. The 11 developer tool pages under src/app/mockups/development are now unreachable duplicates of /admin/developer-hub. The safe-number editor, attendance roster, QR check-in helper and clinical note editor are unwired; wire or remove each, and the note editor needs a privacy review before use. The clinical-math calculators need ideal body weight guidance, a corrected lithium dialysis label, a consistent 1.2 mmol/L boundary and tablet-strength rounding before any use.
